results.title: Yau shugaba Paul Biya ke cika shekaru 44 a karagar mulkin Kamaru
results.content: Yau shugaban Kamaru Paul Biya ke cika shekaru 44 yana jagorancin ƙasar, wanda ya fara daga ranar 6 ga Nuwamban 1982, inda ya maye gurbin marigayi Ahmadou Ahidjo, wanda ya yi murabus a ranar 4 ga watan Nuwamban shekarar ta 1982

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Matakin soke takarar Atiku na ADC ya haifar da cece-kuce a Najeriya
results.content: Hukuncin da babbar kotun tarayyar Najeriya da ke zamanta a Abuja ta yi na soke halascin shugabancin jam’iyyar ADC tsagin David Mark da kuma takarar Alhaji Atiku Abubakar, ya haifr da cecekuce a farfajiyar siyasar Najeriya.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Amnesty ta bayyana damuwa kan harin da aka kai wa ADC a Birnin Kebbi
results.content: Ƙungiyar Amnesty International ta yi Allah wadai da yadda wasu ɓatagari suka kai hari kan tawagar yaƙin neman zaɓen ɗan takarar shugaban ƙasar jam'iyyar ADC a Birnin Kebbi, Atiku Abubakar.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Kotu ta soke halascin ci gaba da mulkin shugaba Hassan na Somalia
results.content: A Somalia, Kotun Koli ta yanke hukunci kan tsawaita wa'adin mulkin shugaban ƙasa wanda ta ce ya saba wa doka sannan ta yi watsi da yunkurin tsige babban alƙalin ƙasar, matakin ya ƙara ruruta wutar rashin tabbas a ƙasar daga jiya Alhamis .

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Gwamnatin Ghana ta bijiro da sabbin matakan rage yawan haɗura a ƙasar
results.content: Shugaban Ghana John Dramani Mahama ya buƙaci al’ummar ƙasar da su yi haƙuri da sabbin matakan da ya ƙaddamar don daƙile matsalar haɗura a kan titunan ƙasar.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Tsanantar bore ya tilastawa Faransa shirya ganawa da ƙungiyoyin ƙwadago
results.content: Firaministan Faransa Sebastien Lecornu, zai gana da shugabannin ƙungiyoyin kwadagon ƙasar a ranar Litinin mai zuwa, bayan zanga-zangar da ɗaruruwan mutane suka gudanar a sassan ƙasar kan buƙatar ƙarin albashi da tsadar makamashi.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Najeriya ta musanta shiga yarjejeniyar zaman lafiya da Boko Haram
results.content: Shalkwatar tsaron Najeriya ta yi watsi da zarge-zargen da ke yawo cewa gwamnatin ƙasar ta shiga wata yarjejeniyar zaman lafiya da mayaƙan Boko Haram, dalili kenan da ya sanya aka sami sauƙin hare-hare.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Fitattun wasanni biyar da Ronaldo ya takawa Portugal kafin ritayarsa
results.content: Wani labari da kafar yaɗa labaran Portugal ta Observador ta fitar, ya ce Cristiano Ronaldo ne yaƙi amincewa da bugawa ƙasar wasan bankwana kamar yadda takwaransa na Argentina Lionel Messi ya yi lokacin na shi ritayar.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Babu ɗan wasan da zai yi amfani da rigar lamba 10 ta Messi - Argentina
results.content: Hukumomin ƙwallon ƙafar Argentina sun yanke shawarar ci gaba da killace fitacciyar riga lamba 10 ta Lionel Messi ba tare da bai wa kowa damar amfani da ita ba a wasanni bayan ritayar gwarzon ɗan wasan.

results.title: Mahaifin shugaban gwamnatin sojin Nijar Tchiani ya rasu
results.content: Bayanai sun ce Allah ya yi wa mahaifin shugaban Gwamnatin Sojin Jamhuriyar Nijar Abdurrahman Tchiani rasuwa a garin Toukounouss na jihar Tillaberi

results.title: Bamu da hannu a haramtawa Atiku tsayawa takara-Gwamnatin Najeriya
results.content: Gwamnatin Najeriya ta musanta hannu a hukuncin kotu da ya fatali da halascin Atiku Abubakar a matsayin ɗan takarar shugaban ƙasa a jam’iyyar ADC.

results.title: Muna zargin Gwamnati da kitsa hukuncin kotu da ya dakatar da takararmu- Atiku
results.content: Ɗan takarar Shugaban Najeriya a jam’iyyar ADC Atiku Abubakar ya yi Allah-wadai da hukuncin kotu wanda ya rushe duk wani mataki da jam’iyyar ta ɗauka ƙarƙashin shugabancin David Mark, wanda ya haɗar da kawo ƙarshen takarar mutanen da tsagin ya tsayar.

results.title: Ƙaddamar da yaƙi kan Iran ne ya haddasa mana rashin nasara a zaɓe- JD Vance
results.content: Mataimakin Shugaban Amurka JD Vance ya janye daga goyon bayan matakin Shugaba Donald Trump kan yaƙin Iran, matakin da ke biyo bayan da jam’iyyar Republican ta sha kaye a zaɓe tsakiyar wa’adin mulki da aka gudanar ranar Laraba.

results.title: Ƙungiyoyin ma'aikata da ƴan fansho sun shiga zanga-zangar ɗalibai ta Faransa
results.content: Dubban mutane sun sake kwarara kan titunan Faransa don ci gaba da zanga-zangar da ɗalibai suka faro kan ƙarancin malamai da rashin ingancin yanayin karatu a ƙasar, sai dai kuma a yau bayanai na cewa ƙungiyoyin ma’aikata, da ƴan fansho ma sun shiga cikin wannan zanga-zanga inda suka buƙatar ƙarin albashi, da kuma rage tsadar rayuwa.

results.title: Bankin BECEAO mai buga kuɗaɗen CFA ya samar da hanyoyin aikewa da kuɗeɗe cikin sauƙi
results.content: Babban bankin da ke buga takardar kuɗin CFA a Yammacin Afirka wato BECEAO (Beseyawo) ya fitar da wata sabuwar manhaja mai suna PI-SPI da ke bai wa ƙasashen yankin damar aikewa da kuɗaɗe a cikin sauƙi.

results.title: Sabon tsarin Kamaru na sabunta katin ɗan ƙasa ya jefa ƴan al'umma cikin zullumi
results.content: A Kamaru ƴan ƙasar na bayyana ƙalubalen da suke fuskanta sakamakon tsadar katin shaidar zama ɗan ƙasa, bayan da gwamnatin ta soke ƙarin wa'adin watanni shida ga mutumin dake ɗauke da tsohon katin, matakin da ke ƙara shafar matafiya sakamakon matsin lamba daga wurin jami'an ƴan sanda.

results.title: Ra'ayoyin masu sauraro kan yadda ƴan adawa ke cigaba da yaƙin neman zaɓe duk da ƙalubale
results.content: A Najeriya yayin da ake ci gaba da yaƙin neman zaɓen gamma-gari da za a yi cikin shekara mai zuwa, ƴan adawa sun yi zagin cewa ana hana su samun damar isa ga filayen da suka dace don gudanar da tarukan gangami, da rashin samun damar wallafa manufofinsu a allunan tallace-tallace da kuma rashin ba su cikakkiyar kariya ta tsaro a wasu jihohin ƙasar.
